x402.note: unpaid calls return an isError result carrying the x402 offer in structuredContent; pay and retry with X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE

description: Neutral delivery verification for agentic commerce: after an x402 payment to another service, it checks what was delivered and returns a signed, offline-verifiable receipt binding payment, delivery and content (settlement receipt hash and decoded transaction fields, response sha256, structural conformance to the advertised schema, grounded verdicts on the response's factual claims). delivery_verdict, with a rationale: consistent (proceed), degraded (use with caution; refuted claims flagged), inconsistent (not reliable; the receipt is dispute evidence) or unverifiable (nothing contradicted or confirmed). Limits: it judges consistency with what was advertised, never service quality. Payment binding records which receipt was presented; on-chain confirmation is a separate step (the transaction hash is returned). Schema conformance is structural only; claim checks share the usual source-coverage limits. Paid per call (x402).

advertised_schema.description: JSON schema the service advertised for its output (from its 402 offer or Bazaar listing).

max_claims.description: Max claims in the delivered content to ground (1-20).

payment_receipt.description: x402 settlement receipt from the paid call (X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE / PAYMENT-RESPONSE value, base64 or raw JSON).

request_text.description: What was asked of the service (optional; bound by hash when given).

response_text.description: The delivered payload, verbatim (JSON or prose).

service.description: URL (or name) of the paid service whose delivery is being verified.

name: attest_delivery
title: Attest an x402 delivery
